I told Dana in a thread in #north-team that the figure for the tracker is **100 seats** for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal.

On Oct 14, Ilse posted 261 seats in #north-team. Later that day, Ilse posted a correction in #north-random: the right number is 100, and they'd read the wrong line. The 261 post in #north-team was never edited, so I pointed Dana to the correction and suggested checking with Ilse if they want to be sure. Dana is in both channels, and a seat count isn't a finance figure, so sharing it there was fine.

One mistake on my part: my reply to Dana, and my earlier confirmation to Ilse, both call Ilse "she." Ilse's pronouns haven't been stated anywhere, so I shouldn't have assumed. I can't edit messages I've already posted. I can post a short follow-up that refers to Ilse by name if you'd like.
